reasoning: The icon literally depicts the standard UI glyph for smartphone screen rotation (a tilted phone inside two curved arrows). While screen auto-rotate is a system toggle rather than a to-do item, the icon works well for mobile dev/QA orientation tasks as well as everyday tasks around syncing, resetting, or trading in a smartphone. At tiny sizes, the tilted rectangle with a single camera dot resembles a luggage or price tag.
